ns2:course.label: Advanced Interpreting Practice and Research
ns2:course.description: Advanced practice in interpreting skills, with an emphasis on simultaneous interpretation from and into English; and study of Research methodology in Interpreting Studies. Other areas of practice may include consecutive interpreting, sight translation and sight interpreting 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: TRST 541, TRST 542, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: TRST 541, TRST 542, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Translation and Interpreting major(s).
